result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion. However, it goes beyond the requested position by extending the return and deletion obligations to all Confidential Information and materials, not just Company/Customer Data. It is also awkward to require all “materials” to be returned in machine-readable form, and “thereafter” leaves the deletion deadline unclear. These are drafting and scope issues, but the unrelated termination-payment and work-product provisions remain substantively unchanged.
